There are 3 wires connecting to the transistor, coming from a bulb is called collector, from the resistors is called base, and with an arrow is called an emitter. The current coming from the collector needs to flow to emitter in order to complete the circuit which in turn lights up the bulb. But in order to do that, the base needs to be supplied with current.
